steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and documented project-management experience. Review your degree level and years leading projects to verify you meet the baseline criteria. Granite PM Academy's advisors can help you assess your qualifications before enrollment.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual PMP Bootcamp, delivered by active certified practitioners. Attend instructor-led sessions on your schedule—no travel required. This formal education counts toward PMI's eligibility requirement and grounds you in the PMBOK® Guide framework.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing the bootcamp, submit your PMI application through the Project Management Institute's portal. Pay the examination fee and complete the credential application process. Granite PM Academy provides step-by-step guidance to ensure your submission is accurate and timely.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice tests, study guides, and instructor office hours—to reinforce knowledge. Schedule your exam at a Pearson VUE testing center. Your bootcamp curriculum directly aligns with PMP content domains to maximize readiness.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: Earn professional development units (PDUs) over a three-year renewal cycle to keep your credential active. Granite PM Academy offers continuing-education courses to help you maintain your PMP while advancing your expertise in petrochemical, energy, maritime, and industrial sectors.
